basis: Congenital cardiac malformation; bronchial compression and bronchomalacia cause respiratory impairment in a substantial proportion (~50% or more).
Eosinophilia and immune-mediated myofascial injury define disease; persistent skin sclerosis ~30-50%; neuropathy near 30% omitted because of cap.
Metabolic defect with defining cardiomyopathy/myopathy; hepatic injury annotated 80-99%; acute metabolic encephalopathy does not establish persistent brain injury.
Muscular torticollis, keloids and renal dysplasia define syndrome; frequencies of additional vascular and neurologic abnormalities are unspecified.
Congenital anomalous articulation between the coracoid process and clavicle; isolated joint abnormality.
Isolated congenital finger fusion with associated digital skeletal abnormalities; cutaneous syndactyly is a limb malformation.
Disordered erythropoiesis with marrow ring sideroblasts; syndromic organ abnormalities and systemic iron injury are not universal across this umbrella.
Monogenic diabetes with impaired endocrine pancreatic function; diabetic organ complications are separate diseases.
Nephrotic FSGS, hydrocephalus and blue-scleral abnormality define syndrome; thin skin alone does not establish additional functional injury.
Secondary PTH excess commonly causes skeletal demineralization/high-turnover bone injury (~30-60%); underlying kidney disease is a cause, not direct involvement.
Cutaneous mastocytosis, hearing loss and microcephaly define syndrome; optic atrophy annotated 80-99%; scoliosis (2/3) and contractures omitted at cap.
Congenital glycosylation defect; intellectual disability 9/15 and motor delay 9/13 establish common neurologic impairment; osteoarthritis 4/15 is below threshold.
Primary palmoplantar epidermal disorder; cystic fibrosis and other associated conditions do not establish involvement of their organs.
Selective tooth agenesis establishes dental involvement; the supplied record does not clarify whether choroid calcification is ocular or intracranial, or damaging.
Inherited plasma-protein metabolic disorder defined by emphysema and hepatic injury; panniculitis is very rare (1-4%).
Combined T/B-cell functional immunodeficiency; reported pneumonias are separately diagnosed infections rather than intrinsic pulmonary disease.
Childhood autoinflammatory disease umbrella; no particular damaged organ is established across most subtypes.
Active ulceration of gastric or duodenal mucosa; an infectious mechanism is not established for every case.
Congenital cardiac malformations, conduction abnormalities and cardiomyopathy define this heart disease.
Metabolic enzyme deficiency; rhabdomyolysis and liver dysfunction are reported, but their frequency and status as defining features are unclear.
AP4B1-related neurodevelopmental and corticospinal disease; skeletal deformities are occasional or lack frequencies supporting common direct involvement.
Inherited structural disease of the mitral valve; no additional organ disease defines this umbrella.
Dermatophyte infection of foot skin; no direct musculoskeletal involvement.
Congenital bilateral obstruction of the posterior nasal airway; the nasal airway belongs to the pulmonary axis.
Temple syndrome has characteristic endocrine growth/puberty abnormalities and early hypotonia with developmental impairment; small hands and feet alone add no skeletal axis.
